findings.detail: [listen].serve is on, and a separate qsh serve is also set up on this machine (a serve service unit, or a running serve recorded in serve.json). Two processes answer forward connections, and the SSH bootstrap finds whichever wrote serve.json last. (a serve service unit is registered)
findings.remedy: Once clients use the combined endpoint's address, stop and remove the serve unit (docs/deploy/service.md) or stop the extra qsh serve. To go back instead, turn [listen].serve off.
